cohort: Women who participated in group prenatal care from 2009 to 2015 were matched with women receiving individual prenatal care based on payer type, prepregnancy BMI, and gestational age at delivery.
finding: Among normal-weight and overweight women, group prenatal care was associated with an increased likelihood of excessive gestational weight gain compared to individual prenatal care.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was used as a matching criterion.
